entityDescription:
RADIO6ENSE is an industrial Spin-off of the University of Roma Tor Vergata aiming at designing and developing short-range distributed RFID sensing technology for Industrial, Civil, Aerospace and Biomedical applications.
RADIO6ENSE originates from 10 years of pioneering research about Radio Frequency Identification carried on by the Pervasive Electromagnetics Lab of University of Roma Tor Vergata. 
The mission is to develop low-cost widespread sensing platforms, perfectly integrated in the environment, for different scenarios, bringing the new paradigms of pervasive sensing in the most varied contexts, even in the most traditional and settled ones.
RADIO6ENSE is supported, for the more conceptual and theoretical issues by the Pervasive Electromagnetic Lab of the University of Roma Tor Vergata. With the University, RADIO6ENSE shares three laboratories: one for modeling and design, one for the prototyping and one for measurements and test.

entityDescription:
ROSEAL S.A. is a SME specialized in manufacturing sealing systems, aiming permanently to fulfill the market - driven requirements for new and innovative performance products through collaboration with R&D Institutes, universities and academy. The experience in seal manufacturing dates back to 1978. Activities include research, design, production and marketing of mechanical and magnetofluidic seals, manufacturing specific spare parts of carbon materials, superaluminous ceramics, elastomers and PTFE and also training and technical assistance.
Our products and services cover a broad range of industrial sectors: pump factories, chemical plants, petrochemical plants, pharmaceutical industry, textile and paints industry, pulp and paper industry, food and beverage industry, nuclear-electric industry, thermal engines, water supply and treatment, installation, internal combustion engines.
S.C. ROSEAL SA has implemented this menu and the Management System Integrates in accordance with the ISO standard (Certification ISO 9001: 2015; ISO 14001: 2015; ISO 45001: 2018) and is authorized for design, manufacturing and services in accordance with CNCAN regulations for quality management in the nuclear field, class 1, ASME code, Section III, Subsection NCA, art. 3800 and 4000 and ISCIR authorization for the manufacture and installation of pressure components according to PT N SCP 1 – 2008.
ROSEAL S.A. became a member and even a founding member of the Romanian Association for Promotion of Magnetic Fluids, Romanian Atomic Forum - ROMATOM, Association of researchers, designers, manufacturers and exporters of circulation pumps in Romania (APPR), MHTC – Magurele High Tech Cluster, FEPA-CM - Employer's Association for Machine Building Industry.
Product portofolio:
-Mechanical and magnetofluidic seals for nuclear equipment, mixer, agitator, reactor, compressor, pump, blower, vacuum application.
-Spare parts manufactured by metal, Silicium Carbid, Wolfram Carbid and in-house made materials (carbon, ceramic, elastomer, PTFE)
-Magnetic nanomaterials: Magnetic nanoparticles (MNP), MNP clusters, magnetic nanofluids (ferrofluids), very high magnetization composite fluids.
Services: technical assistance, seal reconditioning, pump and compressor repairing, training.
Roseal S.A. is developing and manufacturing carbon materials, expanded graphite, superaluminous ceramics, elastomers and PTFE for spare parts. Over the years a large number of specific mechanical seals and components have been designed, built and tested, which currently solve concrete cases of chemical, petrochemical and nuclear power industry.
Being highly receptive to new technologies, ROSEAL Co. has developed long-term S&T cooperation with national Research & Development institutes and high ranked universities from Romania.The company team has gained research experience by participating and leading several national research projects.Among the most important achievements obtained in collaboration with Romanian Academy – Timisoara Branch, Center for Fundamental and Advanced Technical Research, Laboratory of Magnetic Fluid is the synthesis of magnetic nanoparticles, magnetic nanoparticle clusters,magnetic nanofluids and nano-micro structured composite magnetizable fluids even at micropilot scale with excellent quality, used in various long-term (~ 5 years) sealing systems.Advanced research have been performed for achieving polymeric and carbographitic heat-proof materials with increased life-time for seal gaskets exposed to radiation. The output of these researches covered both the qualification procedures and the synthesis procedures. Research results were also disseminated through numerous scientific papers, posters, patents and innovations.

entityDescription:
TSS was founded in 2011 in Roveredo in the Grisons as a spin off of Mollificio Technosprings Italia with the aim to develop research, production and marketing of various possible applications with technology related to the development of the potential of shape memory material .
For this reason TSS takes inside transversal skills that allow them to handle and develop projects and products in many fields: medical, aerospace, mechanical, special machinery, valves, to even up the watch industry.
Thanks to these skills it has already achieved the development of numerous projects of application, filing a patent in an anti-freeze valve developed with SMA.
It is currently making prototypes for a clip for cranial surgery and developing various projects that enhance the characteristics of SMA (superelasticity, shape memory).
For this reason, it is already developing important relationships with companies and organizations such as Liebherr, Epiflex, Swiss Space Center, Auma, Gruppo Swatch...


TSS is a member of AIASI: Aerospace Industries Association of Italian Switzerland.
In the development plan for the next triennium is expected to be opened three production sectors: medical, aerospace, mechanical (for valves and projects related to automotive and oil-gas industry)

entityDescription: XLAB d.o.o. is an SME established in 2001, headquartered in Ljubljana, Slovenia, with a team of 100+ specialists. entityDescription:
green spin GmbH was founded in 2013 and is based in Würzburg. The management team of the start-up company consists of Clemens Delatrée (Business Development), Heiko Fabritius (Product Development), Dr. Sebastian Fritsch (Operational Business) and Gunther Schorcht (Technical Development). A total of eight people currently contribute to the success of the company.
green spin stands for Business Intelligence solutions, digital innovations and new business models based on Open Data. Open data is digital information that anyone can use freely and without restrictions. The primary focus of green spin is the processing of spatial data, so-called geodata. Satellite sensor data in particular can help with, for example, viewing many company processes from a completely new perspective.
green spin analyses this external geodata and uses artificial intelligence, among other things, to derive relevant information for various customer groups. This data is then integrated into existing customer processes using interfaces or visualisation applications. The comprehensive services of green spin include consulting, data services and application development. The company draws on many existing building blocks, and years of experience with previous projects. Substantial experience was gained in particular with developing solutions for the areas of agriculture, commodity trade and water supply. Examples of Smart Farming applications can be found online at www.greenspin.de. 
Typically, green spin customers are looking for innovative digital solutions and a new perspective on their business processes. green spin is open for cooperation in research and development. The emphasis of own current projects is on artificial intelligence, Big Data, data visualisation as well as Open Data based applications and interfaces.

entityName: ŁUKASIEWICZ Research Network - TELE & RADIO RESEARCH INSTITUTE
entityDescription: The Łukasiewicz Research Network – Tele and Radio Research Institute conducts interdisciplinary research and development activities in the area of advanced digital and electronic technologies, addressing key challenges of modern economies. The Institute focuses on three strategic directions: energy transformation, defense and state security, and circular economy. The Institute actively carries out its activities in three strategic directions: Energy Transformation, Defense and State Security, and Circular Economy. Thanks to competencies in the fields of ICT, Internet of Things, sensor technologies, artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), the Institute develops advanced electrotechnical solutions, including Smart Grid systems, energy management systems (EMS), and tools for predictive diagnostics and real-time infrastructure monitoring. In the area of defense and security, advanced photonic, electronic, and automation technologies are implemented, including solutions meeting safety requirements at the NATO level (AQAP). The Institute also supports the circular economy by conducting research and development projects in the co-design of electronics, automation, and digitization of technological processes, as well as technologies for the recovery, regeneration, and reuse of materials, including ultrasonic, vacuum, and electrothermal technologies. The Institute has implemented and continuously improves a Quality Management System compliant with the PN-EN ISO 9001:2015 standard.
